gen-gf-gabarito-gf-titillium-web: Titillium Web has a friendly, contemporary stance, its stroke ends set well apart. And Gabarito up top draws everything with one unchanging nib, so a longer passage in the body feels light against that heading's bold display character.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-tomorrow: Marker-like lines of constant width, with open terminals that let the counters spill outward, mark Gabarito right away. Tomorrow follows with bowls like a cupped palm, and if the heading shrinks or the body grows, that gap in character starts to blur.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-trispace: Trispace spreads its letters sparsely, with curves that open outward instead of curling in. Trispace gives the pair its strongest quality: a wide, breathing body that lets Gabarito's wire-bent display letters stand out.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Gabarito looks bent from a single nib, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. Tsukimi Rounded replies with round forms like open parentheses, edges running parallel through every curve, so the two share a page without crowding each other.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-tuffy: Loose, sketchy, and a bit cheeky: Gabarito draws with one nib and lets its terminals open wide. And Tuffy, written like a pencil that never presses harder, has a widely parted s, which leaves the heading free to carry big, short lines.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-urbanist: Expressive is the first word for Gabarito, drawn with one nib and open terminals that let each counter flow outward. Urbanist works the other way, a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut and trails like a rolling-ball pen, built for steady text instead of display flair.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-varela-round: Gabarito looks drawn with one nib, its terminals cut open. Varela Round gives the pair its strongest quality, a modern, clean body whose same-width strokes frame wide-mouthed rounds in the lowercase.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-varta: Gabarito draws with one nib. Its vertical and horizontal strokes carry identical weight, and its terminals open outward, while Varta does the quieter work of text, with big open eyes on every e and a.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-vazirmatn: Vazirmatn reads approachable and modern, its s wide open and never tightening. Gabarito earns its keep up top, where flat, contrast-free letterforms with open terminals look best big and short.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-wix-madefor-display: A marker-like line of constant width, with terminals cut open, makes Gabarito instantly recognizable. Wix Madefor Display follows with gently flared curve ends that stay apart, so a longer stretch of sans-serif text goes down smoothly under that loud heading.
